primary.title: Hanassy et al.2015 · Stereotypical reaching movements involve bend propagation and elongation
primary.type: Primary kinematic study; actual indexed abstract read
primary.scope: The actual PubMed abstract describes3D reaching reconstructions and variable proximal elongation in nominal Octopus vulgaris. Only selected conceptual mechanisms are illustrated; no trajectories, strain values, fitted forces, full paper figures or video were obtained.

primary.title: Levy and Hochner2017 · Embodied organization of morphology, vision and locomotion
primary.type: Author perspective with selected experimental figures; actual publisher PDF inspected
primary.scope: Actual publisher PDF printedpages3–4 Figure1 andFigure2 were rendered/inspected, with selected text. They show irregular recruitment/contact records and aquarium frames/eye roll in nominal Octopus vulgaris; Figure1 also includes insect comparisons. This is a perspective, not a newly retrieved primary2015 full dataset or fitted control model. No source figures are redistributed.

primary.title: Allen et al.2014 · Comparative morphology of changeable skin papillae
primary.type: Primary comparative morphology; indexed abstract and selected author-hosted PDF text
primary.scope: Selected author-hosted PDF text and indexed abstract were read. A new figure download/render did not succeed. The study distinguishes several cephalopod species and prepared tissue, including nominal O.vulgaris small dorsal/ventral eye papillae from Florida; modern common-octopus-complex identity is not redetermined. No other species compound papillae, measured microanatomy or internal muscles are copied into this surface. Cellular pigment/relief is original numerical artwork guided qualitatively by authentic photographs.

references.scope: No new photo pixels or third-party figures used in numerical materials. Measurements and validation remain unavailable.

limitations: This remains an unmeasured, partly stylized external adult study. The asymmetric spread is one authored inspection posture, not a fitted resting individual. Selected arm lengths, distal curling/taper, web thickness and unions, head/eye position, iris/cornea, mantle wall/cavity, papilla distribution and pigment/optical diversity are approximate. The retained38sucker pairs per arm, radial grooves and short orifices do not reconstruct complete acetabula or fine circumferential/microscopic tissue. A cleared illustrative funnel route does not establish internal anatomical fidelity, valves, respiratory organs, pressure or water flow. Proximal extension/radius adjustment and a travelling bend are authored mechanisms, not measured strains or a muscular-hydrostat solver. Selected distal support regions compensate for body translation; suction, mucus/traction, force equilibrium, whole-body and between-sample contact/collision freedom, complete crawling, prey handling and jet escape remain unavailable. Coded finite sequences are not an inferred motor-controller or measured cadence. Skin fields are original numerical artwork, not photograph/SEM pixels, camouflage physiology or calibrated natural optics. Compatibility/export uses restrained coarse numerical grain instead of the main cellular shader detail, with reduced fidelity. No90-percent score, independent specialist review or biological validation is claimed.
